name: WE-Invoice
description: Free invoicing and eFaktúra (Peppol) for Slovak sole traders and small companies: invoices, PDF with PAY by square, VAT reports, simple bookkeeping. Web, iOS/Android PWA, macOS and Windows. Data encrypted in your own Google Drive.

paragraphs: Free invoicing and eFaktúra (Peppol) for Slovak sole traders and small companies.
Invoices with PAY by square, VAT reports and simple bookkeeping. Your data stays encrypted in your own Google Drive.

WE Invoice is the third free app of the WE line by White Eagles, after WE Time Tracker and WE Budget. It does what paid Slovak invoicing services charge 5 to 15 € a month for, with no plans, no limits on contacts, documents or companies, and no registration.
features: Free, really. Every feature for everyone: recurring invoices, reminders, bank import, several companies, all languages. White Eagles runs no data servers, so there is nothing to charge for.
Your data stays yours. Everything is encrypted on your device (AES-GCM 256) and stored in a "WE Invoice" folder of your own Google Drive. Export everything at any time: JSON, XML, PDF, CSV.

Ready for eFaktúra 2027. From 1 January 2027 Slovak VAT payers issue domestic B2B invoices through Peppol, and every business must be able to receive them. WE Invoice sends and receives them through the certified…
Made for Slovak law. Particulars of § 74 of the VAT act are checked before a document is issued; rates, limits, deadlines and legal texts live in a dated configuration, never in code.
